mu_name_from: MuMain _enum.h MONSTER_ALPHA_CRUST (74), drawn as MONSTER_MODEL_CRUST = 52 (_enum.h:4202), Monster53.bmd, the Mega Crust's body. OpenMU Version095d Maps/Icarus.cs:291 names breed 74 'Alpha Crust'. docs/icarus-port.md.
monster_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:13588-13611, CreateMonster, case MONSTER_ALPHA_CRUST: Scale = 1.3f; Weapon[0] = MODEL_THUNDER_BLADE and Weapon[1] = MODEL_LEGENDARY_SHIELD, both at Level 9; BlendMesh = 1 at light 1. RenderCharacter draws it with its MonsterIndex as ExtraMon (:8645-8651), and RenderObject's MODEL_CRUST arm lights such a body BodyLight (0.1, 1, 0.8) (ZzzObject.cpp:1354-1358): a teal Crust. Its effects are the Mega Crust's, in game/play: RenderEye at 2 (:11213-11215), its blow's Inferno at CheckAttackTime(5) (:1696-1708), the Thunder Blade's and the shield's held sparks. Left out, as the Mega Crust's: the CPhysicsCloth cape, here on iui03.tga (:8820-8838).
mesh_from: Its own build of Monster53, not a pointer at MegaCrust01's: AlphaCrust01.obj and .rig.json are the same export, because MU's BodyLight is baked into its sheets (see sheet_from) and a sheet is baked into the body's glb, as the Death Beam Knight's own build of the Beam Knight.
right_hand_from: The Mega Crust's arms and bones (ZzzCharacter.cpp:11962-11965), both at +9.
rig_from: MegaCrust01's export: --actions=all, 7 actions, 55 bones; keys 6, 6, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7. Its death plays at 0.22 (ZzzOpenData.cpp:3738-3745), in actions.json's action_overrides.
sheet_from: The Mega Crust's iui01 and iui02 with MU's BodyLight (0.1, 1, 0.8) multiplied in, red by 0.1 and blue by 0.8, its alpha kept: RenderBody lights every vertex of the body, the BlendMesh flames too, by BodyLight (ZzzObject.cpp:1356-1357). Made from crust_iui01.png and crust_iui02.png, nothing else changed.
sheet_materials_from: iui01 is painted plate, painted_steel; iui02 is drawn as a glow, so its material only names it.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V and striping plate; the armour sets' cast grain instead, as the Tarkan monsters.
soft_alpha_from: iui01.OZT is drawn by MU tested and blended (EnableAlphaTest): the plate's frosted rim feathers out.
glow_from: BlendMesh 1 at light 1: mesh 1, the flames (iui02), drawn added (ZzzBMD.cpp:1509-1516), and MoveCharacterVisual slides its U: `o->BlendMeshTexCoordU = -(float)((int)(WorldTime) % 10000) * 0.0004f` (ZzzCharacter.cpp:5819-5821), 0.4 of the sheet a second.
sounds_from: The Crust model's, SetMonsterSound(..., 180, 180, 181, 181, 182), ZzzOpenData.cpp:3738-3745. Wired as alphacrust_* in sounds.json, as megacrust_*.
